brief: Develop and execute a two-echelon manufacturer-retailer model in which manufacturer and retailer advertising have asymmetric effects: one advertising channel may partly substitute for the other at low intensity but become complementary above a threshold. brief: Using public UN E-Government Development Index components and World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators, assess whether digital-government maturity helps explain cross-country control of corruption over the common years available from 2010 to 2024. brief: Build and test a hybrid linear and nonlinear model for forecasting the monthly Global Economic Policy Uncertainty index one, three and six months ahead.
